notes.title: Greetings dear people of the Small World!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the release of A Spider's Web expansion alongside some improvement!

Complete changelog:
- A Spider's Web Expansions
- IceWitches Race
- Skags Race
- Slingman Race
- Lava Power
- Copycat Power
- SoulTouch Power
- No line break in resume game cell.
- Wealthy is now activating the first time we copy it even if is not the first turn of the combo.
- Winter token now returns to the player's hand when using the lava token on a region with the winter token.
- Winter Token no more take account to the adjacent region for conquest purposes.
- Combo Soul-Touched is now visible until the next turn with the Soul-Touche angel on it.
- When click on one Loot token you now see all loot tokens at the same time.
- Fix some word cut on English rules.
- Rename Gypsy to Nomad and Pygmy to Witch Doctor
- Login banner can check who is connected to the app and if the user has an Internet connection And the Status of DoW server


Good luck in your conquest and the destruction of your neighbors!

notes.title: New update available v.3.0.3
notes.notes:
It's been a while! How everyone is doing?

We are delighted to announce the release of a brand new update for Small World! 
You can check the patch notes in details here:

[list]
[*]When the bot plays Hordes of Pixies and they Redeploy they should not leave a token \"Hordes of\" but only tokens of Pixies"
[*]The priestess tower is now working while controlling ghouls in decline "
[*]Bug fix freeze when the bot plays Ransacking Sorcerers.
[*]On Android, you can move from screen to screen without lag (experience is more fluid).
[*]When you look at the Recent opponents you should see the list of the players you played with, that way you may add them to my buddies list"
[*]Ransacking animation is visible so we can better understand the coin being stolen from opponent.
[*]Die indicator when use mercenary to conquest a region is not visible.
[*]You can resume your multisession online game even though other player is not on the game and game is finish.
[/list]
We wanted to thank you all for your loyalty over the past few years. Small World is back to work so get ready to deploy your armies!

Have fun and good luck in your conquests!

notes.title: Grab Carcassone and Splendor for cheaps in Fanatical s digital board games sale
notes.notes:
Sometimes, when a board game loves a personal computer very much, they create something new. Fanatical have got seven digified board games on sale, and there are some gooduns tucked between those I’m not familiar with. Small World 2 and Splendor are my highlights, though there’s also the likes of Pandemic, Carcassonne, Mysterium and Ticket To Ride.

Digital board games tend to be a poor substitute for playing against real world fleshsacks. But sometimes there are no fleshsacks within reach.

(more…)

notes.title: Small World 2.5 Update is Available!
notes.notes:
[h1]Introducing Small World 2.5[/h1] 
Featuring an even more refined online game system that delivers the best of both asynchronous and competitive online play, Small World 2.5 now gives you:
[list]
[*] A full-featured [i][b]Lobby[/b][/i] with real-time chat, list of connected players, game creation and list of open games to join. Within this [i][b]Online Arena[/b][/i] you’ll find a thriving community of avid Small World players ready to play 24/7.
[*] New [i][b]Single-Session[/b][/i] Online games – real-time gaming with bots taking over when someone quits. Even better, all games now run with a [i][b]Speed Chess-like[/b][/i] competitive Player clock that controls how much time each player has left to play. 
[*] [i][b]Multi-Session[/b][/i] Online games – the asynchronous gaming already in Small World 2, but with even more options to control who gets invited, how long your game will last, and a myriad of other options regarding ranked games, karma filtering, starting player selection, and more.
[*] We’ve also implemented more of everything: More ranking, persistent in-game chat, chat in the final score screen, and a super detailed [i][b]statistics screen[/b][/i] at the end of each game to analyze how each player performed with various race/power combinations.
[*] And last but not least, we now provide a [i][b]Linux version[/b][/i], included in the same SteamPlay™ package!
[/list]

notes.title: Small World 2.5 in Open Beta!
notes.notes:
For the past 6 months, we've been hard at work on the next digital version: Small World 2.5. We've added a new "Online Arena" with a live lobby, a list of open games, and full chat capability; support for single-session games, with a new Player Clock for competitive game play; a new Stats screen at game end; improved AI and much more.

Before this new version launches, we want to make sure we got it right, and that it really scales up, so we would like to get as many concurrent players as we can competing against each other in the coming days.

So please come and try it! In your Steam Library, select the game's Steam "Properties", go to the "BETAS" tab and switch to the "[b]beta_version[/b]" item.

Make sure you read the explanations on http://www.daysofwonder.com/msg/?th=29279 about the Beta Program. Using the Beta requires that you agree with the terms described in the Beta Program.

We look forward to hearing from you, have fun with the Beta!

notes.title: Small World 2 is now available for Macintosh
notes.notes:
[b]Small World 2[/b], the massive digital version of our best-selling epic fantasy board game continues to roll out over new territory – for the first time, Small World is now available for the Macintosh via the Steam platform.

Mac Steam players will find all kinds of online competition waiting for them as they join the thousands of Small World 2 players already on the Days of Wonder Online network.



Small World 2 on Mac Steam includes just about anything a Small World fan could ask for:
[list]
[*] 2 to 5 player maps to conquer, in glorious high resolution!
[*] Play Online games in real-time or turn-by-turn, with friends & strangers from the world over; and Local games over Wifi
[*] Playing with friends online is easy with extensive Days of Wonder Online Buddies integration
[*] Solo Play against up to 4 built-in AI
[*] Pass’n Play with up to 5 live players on a single device
[*] 14 original Small World Races and 20 Special Powers
[*] 20 additional Races & Special Powers to master through in-app purchases of Cursed!, Grand Dames, and Be Not Afraid… expansions
[*] Online, Solo, & Face to Face scores with daily, weekly, and perpetual rankings
[*] A comprehensive Small World Encyclopedia detailing all rules, races, special powers, icons, & more!
[/list]
If you are ready to be invaded by this zany cast of fantasy characters, now is the time to get [url=store.steampowered.com/app/235620]Small World 2 for your Mac[/url].
